description.value:
You once worked as an operator or technician at Mordenheim Kinetics, carrying out ethically dubious work in the facility's darkest depths. Then something you did angered the powers that be, and you were harshly punished. Perhaps you had a crisis of conscience and tried to sabotage Dr. Mordenheim's work, or perhaps you did everything right and have no idea why you were punished.

Either way, company security seized you in the night. You woke up in one of Mordenheim Kinetics' filthy waste disposal chambers, where failed experiments are broken down into parts to be reused. You escaped that gruesome fate, and you now live on the edges of the facility, a disgraced outcast. With little left to lose, you are determined to uncover the truth about the shadowy company that once employed you.

Ability Scores: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.9UNJXujWE0F0ekYU]{Gathered Whispers} or a Dark Gift feat of your choice

Skill Proficiencies: Medicine and Nature

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulTinkersToo]{Tinker's Tools} (as engineer's toolkit)

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulTinkersToo]{Tinker's Tools} (as engineer's toolkit); or (B) 50 GP (as 50 dollars)
